items.title: Erdős Problem 151 — cliqueFree three
items.excerpt: If G is triangle-free, then τ(G)≤ n-H(n): the complement of an independent set meets every edge.

items.title: Erdős Problem 151 — sqrt bound
items.excerpt: It is easy to see that τ(G)≤ n-√n. We state this with ⌊√n⌋: with the real square root the bound fails for a single edge (n = 2, τ = 1).

items.title: Erdős Problem 556 — benevides skokan large even
items.excerpt: Benevides and Skokan [BeSk09] settled the even case for large n: for all sufficiently large even n, R(C_n; 3) = 2n.

items.title: Erdős Problem 556 — kss large odd
items.excerpt: Kohayakawa, Simonovits and Skokan [KSS05] settled the conjecture for large odd n: for all sufficiently large odd n, R(C_n; 3) = 4n - 3.
